answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The pulse of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The relic holds work receipts rather than names, so the garden of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
